title: Make the lifecycle expiry test catch a write that commits before an expiry refusal
outcome: Make the lifecycle expiry test catch a write that commits before an expiry refusal
acceptance: session_status with a seeded, already-expired unbegun grant: an expired frame leaves the store snapshot unchanged and the grant issued; the same frame in time changes the snapshot and expires the grant

completion.summary: Added a deterministic lifecycle-expiry regression with an already-due unbegun grant. The expired status frame preserves the complete durable snapshot and issued grant; the same frame in time changes the snapshot and expires the grant. Landed in Batch C and independently accepted.
